title: Disposition run record
description: Per run: record classes evaluated, records disposed (counts and identifiers or key destruction IDs), records deferred by hold, schedule version.

title: Legal hold register
description: Hold records with scope, authority, placed and released times, and blocked actions.

title: Key destruction and sanitization record
description: Key destruction events with key IDs, scope, timestamp and provider confirmation; annual review of the provider's sanitization attestation.
producer: not yet assigned (candidate: managed key service audit log)

title: Backup expiry and restore-replay test
description: Backup inventory with expiry dates and keys, and annual restore test results showing erasure replay correctness.

title: Post-erasure chain verification
description: Chain verification result after each erasure, plus projection rebuild completion and a plaintext scan of derived stores.

title: Records production drill
description: Annual drill producing a defined record set for a tenant in readable form, with elapsed time and completeness check.

title: Deletion certificate and evidence bundle
description: Folio certificate plus machine-readable bundle of evidence IDs, hashes and retained-data statement.

title: Retention precedence rule set with counsel approval and key-destruction block evidence
description: Versioned rule set mapping each record class to its retention obligations and the precedence (legal hold, then regulatory or tax retention, then deletion request), counsel approval record, and per-event evidence that key destruction was blocked for classes under retention or hold.
producer: not yet assigned (intended: Unbound retention service; not built)
